# JARVIS v2.3.0 Release Notes

### Highlights & Critical Updates:

- **100% Non-Root Architecture (Zero Superuser Privilege Dependencies)**:
  - **Complete Non-Root Operation**: The entire JARVIS ecosystem is now 100% non-root. All superuser/root execution paths have been permanently eliminated in favor of safe, robust Android system APIs.
  - **Native Accessibility Automation**: Complete automation of apps, gestures, reels scrolling, hands-free text input, and button clicks running natively through `JarvisAccessibilityService`.
  - **Universal Device Compatibility**: 100% operational on standard unrooted Android devices without voiding warranty, bypassing Knox, or triggering security integrity issues.

- **Cross-App Hands-Free Messaging & Smart In-Chat Typing**:
  - **WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, SMS Automation**: Execute full-cycle cross-app messaging commands (e.g. *"WhatsApp pe [name] ko message type karke bhej do: [message]"*, *"Instagram par [name] ko message bhej do"*, *"Telegram par..."*).
  - **Context-Aware In-Chat Typing**: When already inside any active chat screen (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, etc.), JARVIS intelligently identifies the active message input field via Accessibility node traversal, enters the message, and triggers the send action seamlessly.
  - **Extended NLP Intent Parsing (`CommandParser.kt`)**: Added comprehensive regex and fuzzy matcher patterns supporting conversational Hinglish variants (*"pe"*, *"par"*, *"type karke bhej do"*, *"send kardo"*, *"bhejo"*).

- **Clean, Unified "About JARVIS" & "App Identity" Experience (`dialog_about.xml` & `AboutDialogManager.kt`)**:
  - **Concise & Consistent Visual Layout**: Streamlined the layout to focus on essential identity metrics, matching the clean App Identity aesthetic without excessive clutter.
  - **Complete Surface Hierarchy Synchronization**: Integrated directly with `SurfaceThemeController` supporting `SurfaceRole.DIALOG`, `SurfaceRole.CARD`, `SurfaceRole.PILL_BUTTON`, and `SurfaceRole.ICON_CONTAINER`.
  - **Permanent Developer Attribution**: Prominently highlights Developer (**SILENT SOUL**), Copyright notice (**SILENT SOUL**), Official Application ID (`com.jarvis.assistant`), and dynamic version badge (`Version 2.3.0 (Build 13)`).
  - **Zero Security & Diagnostic Bloat**: Completely removed raw signing certificate SHA-256 hashes, local signature check strings, and server status indicators from both dialogs.
  - **Integrated Creator Community Hub**: Embedded interactive Telegram (`@arif_x9`) and Instagram (`@arif._.96`) themed pill buttons with safe deep-link navigation via `SocialRedirectHelper` in both dialogs.
  - **Universal Drawer & Settings Integration**: Accessible seamlessly with full surface syncing from the Navigation Drawer, Settings Footer, and Settings App Identity row.

- **Privacy Policy & Sovereign Data Governance Section (`PrivacyShieldActivity.kt`)**:
  - **Complete Removal of Open Source References**: Completely eliminated all legacy references to "Open Source" and "source code" across the entire codebase and UI.
  - **Dedicated Privacy Policy & Data Governance Card**: Cleanly integrated into `activity_privacy_shield.xml` with zero-telemetry guarantees and quick-check shield highlights.
  - **Interactive 7-Article Privacy Policy Dialog (`dialog_privacy_policy.xml`)**:
    1. *Zero-Backend & Zero-Database Architecture*: No developer servers, no cloud databases, no user accounts.
    2. *Voice, Wake-Word & Biometric Privacy*: Continuous offline Vosk hardware listening, on-device encrypted voiceprints, ephemeral direct TLS 1.3 to Gemini Live.
    3. *100% Non-Root Safe Accessibility Automation*: Pure user-initiated action execution, zero keylogging, zero password tracking, immediate node purging.
    4. *Camera & Optical Perception*: User-initiated visual sessions only with standard Android security indicators.
    5. *Complete User Data Sovereignty & Deletion*: Permanent one-tap erase and exportable PDF transcripts.
    6. *Zero Advertising & Third-Party Trackers*: No ad SDKs, no user monetization, no data brokers.
    7. *Architect Attribution*: Architect & Lead Developer: **SILENT SOUL**.

- **Girlfriend Mode (Afreen) Polish & End-of-Turn Cleanup**:
  - **Permanent Eradication of Trailing Words & Religious Chants**:
    - Resolved model hallucination where the AI companion would append trailing religious chants or phrases (e.g. *"Radhe"*, *"Radhey"*, *"Radhe Radhe"*, *"Ram Ram"*) at the end of speech turns.
    - Enforced **ABSOLUTE ZERO TOLERANCE FOR TRAILING WORDS & MANTRAS** in system prompt directives.
    - Mandated strict speech completion discipline: *"When your thought is complete, STOP TALKING IMMEDIATELY. Silence is the only valid state."*
  - **Voice Temperature Stabilization**: Tuned Google Gemini Live voice 'Aoede' temperature to **`0.70`** across `PromptGenerator.kt` and `GeminiLiveWebSocket.kt`, maintaining intimate romantic warmth while eliminating tail-token sampling spread.
  - **Real-Time Text & Speech Normalizer Filtering**: Enhanced `SpeechTextNormalizer.cleanTrailingArtifacts` to sanitize any trailing artifacts from chat logs and TTS queues.
  - **Silence Nudge Safety**: Updated dynamic silence nudge prompts to prevent trailing words during unprompted conversational check-ins.

- **Global Header Swipe Gesture Navigation**:
  - **Fluid Swipe-to-Open Drawer**: Integrated `HeaderSwipeGestureHelper` across all activity header bars. Swiping horizontally or dragging downward on the top bar smoothly deploys the global navigation drawer (`GlobalDrawerMenuSheet`) from anywhere in the app.

- **Exportable PDF Transcripts & User Rules Engine**:
  - **Formatted Chat Transcripts (`JarvisPdfGenerator.kt`)**: Generate styled multi-page PDF documents of conversation history with customizable date ranges and sharing capabilities.
  - **User Custom Rules (`UserRulesManager`)**: Define persistent behavioral guidelines that customize assistant actions, persona traits, and execution rules.

# JARVIS v2.2.1 Release Notes (Archive)

### Highlights & Critical Updates:

- **Tiered Version Deprecation & Dynamic Grace Period Kill-Switch**:
  - **Archaic Version Instant Block (`hardBlockedBeforeCode`)**: Any build strictly older than the minimum threshold (e.g. <= 2.1.0 / build 10) is instantly and irrevocably blocked on launch with zero grace period. The app prevents background AI execution and blocks dismissal.
  - **Targeted Version Grace Period (`gracePeriod`)**: Specific recent builds (e.g. 2.2.0 / build 11) can be granted a temporary 2–3 hour deprecation countdown buffer with a live ticking countdown timer. Once the server deadline passes, it automatically transitions to a hard block in real time.
  - **Un-Bypassable Hardware Lock**: Non-cancelable modal with hardware back-press consumption routing directly to app exit (`finishAffinity()`), eliminating bypasses via back button or touch outside.
  - **Tamper-Resistant Offline Persistence**: Once a version is identified as hard-blocked, its state is securely remembered in `AppPreferences`, preventing users from bypassing the lock by toggling airplane mode. Updating to the latest build (2.2.1) automatically clears the lock.
  - **Authoritative Server Time Sync**: Evaluates expiration against server HTTP `Date` headers and cache-busted manifests (`?_ts=...`), preventing device clock manipulation and eliminating CDN lag.

- **Chat Lifecycle & Active Session Separation**:
  - **Clean Display on Startup**: When the app opens or restarts, the active chat screen starts completely clean and uncluttered without old message clutter.
  - **Real-Time Active Conversation Display**: All dialogue turns taking place during the open app session are rendered dynamically on screen.
  - **Dual Action Header (New Chat & Delete History)**:
    - **New Chat (`+` button)**: Clears active turns on the display so the user can start a fresh conversation while safely retaining past conversations in the persistent archive.
    - **Delete History (`Delete` button)**: Positioned directly next to the New Chat button with a non-destructive confirmation dialog (`AlertDialog`) to permanently erase all chat history, conversation context tracking, and short-term memory.
    - **Surface & Theme Synchronized**: Both action buttons are wrapped in 44x44dp square pill containers dynamically responding to active theme surfaces (`SurfaceRole.PILL_BUTTON`).

- **Intelligent Response Modality (Typing Text Mode vs. Live Voice Mode)**:
  - **Typing in Chat -> Pure Text Response**: When the user sends a typed message in `ChatFragment`, the response appears strictly as text on the screen. All incoming audio chunks and TTS are fully suppressed, active audio playback is immediately stopped, and the reply streams in real-time word-by-word into the chat bubble (`ChatRepository.updateStreamingResponse`).
  - **Speaking via Mic -> Real-Time Audio Response**: When the user speaks live through the microphone (or taps the mic/orb), full high-fidelity speech synthesis output via `AudioPlayer` is automatically active, delivering natural spoken conversation alongside chat transcript logging.
  - **Crosstalk & Ambient Noise Shield**: While a typed chat turn is actively processing, microphone audio streaming is temporarily paused so room acoustics, breathing, or background noise do not interfere with text responses. Pure voice streaming resumes immediately upon completion.

- **Universal Multi-Mode Past History Recall (Kal Ki Baatein)**:
  - **Relative Date & Timestamp Archival**: Chat history is formatted chronologically with human-readable relative time markers (`Today (Aaj)`, `Yesterday (Kal)`, `2 days ago (Parso)`, or full date).
  - **Multi-Persona Continuity**: When asked about past conversations, ALL personas (JARVIS, Afreen / Girlfriend Mode, SILENT SOUL, Code Mode) immediately inspect the archive and summarize yesterday's topics with complete fidelity in their respective voice.

- **Developer Social Profiles Dock in Settings & Drawer**:
  - **Dual-Pill Themed Social Dock**: Integrated Instagram (`arif._.96`) and Telegram (`@arif_x9`) profile pills in both the Navigation Drawer and Settings Fragment.
  - **Dynamic Surface & Accent Tinting**: Full integration with `SurfaceThemeController` (`SurfaceRole.DRAWER_CONTAINER` / `SurfaceRole.PILL_BUTTON`) and reactive accent palettes.
  - **Safe Deep-Link Redirection**: Uses `SocialRedirectHelper` with deep-link URI schemes, falling back gracefully to web links if apps are not installed.

- **Permanent Developer Attribution Lock (SILENT SOUL)**:
  - **Zero User-Profile Leakage**: "Architect & Developer" is permanently, immutably locked to **SILENT SOUL** on every device and in all screens.
  - **Complete Project-Wide Alignment**: Verified and updated all internal branding, HTML documentation, and identity headers across the entire project to strictly attribute **SILENT SOUL**.
